items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: No, I never heard him out there.

ctx.x: Well, yeah, when they called the name of Jimmy Newell I couldn't get that together. I don't know where he come from. They called him Jimbo here. That's by calling that nickname, you understand? That's true at all. You take all those men, I know all those boys. Drew Robson, the triumphant player went away from here. Joe Oliver. I'm sure I know him. I'm just awake with all those men. Wake with them when they reckoned when they didn't meet him, it would come there. That's all you representing. Theo sent me, Luis…
Did you sit in with Ori out there? Uh-uh. You never did play with him out there in California?

No, I never heard him out there. When I went there, let's see, I believe he had a boy in Crowley from Texas and a trumpet from somewhere else he had on it. When I went in this music hall, we talked a long time. That was a room about big as this. All them boys, pictures on the wall, piano there, drum, bass, callers. Band system, the crown of the airbag. I went out to different places to look at them little funny bands, bop bands.
